summary_md: **Russ Salakhutdinov ([@rsalakhu](https://x.com/rsalakhu/status/2116238535640465879))** introduces *Training Foundation Models with a Single Algorithm* ([arXiv 2610.40564](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40564), [project](https://yudasong.github.io/unified-training/)): **Unified Training**, built on MaxRL, merges pretraining, midtraining, SFT and RL under one maximum-likelihood objective, improving accuracy, efficiency and harder-problem generalization while reducing forgetting.
